missing_headers.purpose: Enforces HTTPS connections and prevents SSL-stripping attacks.
Restricts resource loading origins and mitigates XSS/data injection.
Mitigates Clickjacking by forbidding unauthorized framing.
Prevents MIME-type sniffing of response payloads.
Controls how much referrer information is included with requests.
Restricts browser feature access (geolocation, camera, microphone).
